content.title: Explore our various teams
content.description:
We’ve worked hard to create a community of forward-thinking people that are personally and professionally invested in Revolut’s mission. 

Our teams bring together experienced talent and inspirational new voices to build a collaborative space to learn and grow.

content.title: Discover our values
content.description: We believe that any success at Revolut comes from two things: our people and our culture. Our culture is our DNA, it defines who we are, how we operate, and how we handle disagreements with each other. We operate, hire, develop, and promote brilliant people based on the values below.

items.title: Get It Done
items.description: Revoluters always push through!  We stopped listening to excuses a long time ago - we care about results. We believe that grit, determination, skill, smartness, and courage can break through almost any wall.

items.title: Deliver WOW
items.description: We love building great products, we love delighting our customers, we love turning the complexity of a chaotic world into the simplicity of a beautiful solution that truly solves customer needs.

items.title: Dream Team
items.description: We select, coach, and retain the top talent only and give them all the support to achieve greatness

items.title: Never Settle
items.description: Revolut is for those who always strive for excellence, for those who want to become the best in the world at what they do, for those who would never settle for less. Revolut is for 10x people.

items.title: Think Deeper
items.description: Logic, reason, and common sense prevail over everything else in decision making at Revolut. We are open-minded, we listen, and we are always in search of the truth.

content.title: Meet the Revoluters
content.description: Check out what life at Revolut is all about

content.description: No ping pong tables or bean bag chairs, just benefits you actually want

content.description:

  • Flexibility to work from home, the office or abroad

  • Exciting events year-round so you can get to know your team

translations.widget.careersApplication.interviewTrans: Tick “I consent” above if you agree to us using AI to record a written transcript and summarise your interviews (video or audio will not be recorded). The transcripts and summaries will be used to help our interviewers fill in their interview scorecards, which means we will be able to assess you more fairly and provide you with more timely and accurate feedback. Consent is entirely optional and will not impact your employment prospects. You can withdraw your consent at any time by emailing us at dpo@revolut.com or by notifying your interviewer during any interview.

Tick “Yes, I consent” above if you agree to us using AI to: (1) transcribe and summarise human-led interviews (no audio recorded); and (2) conduct, temporarily record audio, transcribe, and analyse responses for the AI-led Culture Fit Assessment. Transcripts and AI insights help recruiters and interviewers complete their scorecards for fairer assessment and faster feedback. By consenting, you also explicitly agree to the processing of any sensitive personal data (e.g., health information, political opinions, religious, or philosophical beliefs) you voluntarily disclose. Consent is entirely optional and will not impact your application. You can withdraw consent at any time by emailing dpo@revolut.com or contacting your recruiter. For further information, please refer to the <privacyLink>Data Privacy Notice for Candidates</privacyLink> and <cultureFitLink>Culture Fit Assessment Privacy Notice</cultureFitLink>.
